title: It looks better than it works
text: It looks better than it works. It is a little "rough around the edges", not quite as smooth as I thought it would be. Noisy and just not too precision designed!

product_metadata.title: KRUPS 8000035978 GX5000 Professional Electric Coffee Burr Grinder with Grind Size and Cup Selection, 7-Ounce, Black
features: Metallic flat burr coffee grinder for coffee lovers Power 110 W
Burr mill system avoids overheating, preserves aroma and has grind fineness selector for a precise grinding
The electric coffee grinder has 9 grind levels for a range of drip, cold brew, and pour over coffee grind
8 oz Clear bean container; quantity selector from 2 to 12 cups to grind the exact quantity you need
For safety, if the bean container and/or the lid is not properly in place to active the micro switches, the espresso grinder will not operate

Adjust the fineness level for any type of coffee through 9 main grind settings with 5 intermediary steps each The cup selector lets you choose between 2 to 12 cups, while the auto stop function provides full control and safety Convenient features complete the package: a removable 15 oz container, a removable top burr for effortless cleaning, and a large capacity 7 oz clear coffee bean container
description: The new KRUPS Professional Burr Grinder GX5000 will ensure the best flavor and a perfect result in cup. Its Burr mill system ensures the best grinding results, will preserve aroma and avoid overheating. It also features a fineness selector: 45 settings divided in 9 steps, to allow a highly controllable texture, from very fine for espresso machines to very coarse for the use in a French press. The number of cups selector (2 12) will enable you to adjust the quantity of brewed coffee you need. The KRUPS Professional Burr Grinder GX5000 also features a coffee container with lid to preserve freshness and flavor of ground coffee. For safety reasons the GX5000 Coffee Grinder will not work unless lid of hopper and coffee container are in place and the unit will automatically stop once the designated quantity has been achieved. Topped with a large capacity hopper, the grinder fills effortlessly and provides easy access to its removable burr as well as cleaning brush for cleaning. Enjoy a perfectly balanced cup of coffee every morning with the KRUPS GX5000.Product can only work on 120V per US’s standard
